home.orgDescription: HNUDAO is dedicated to connecting blockchain learning, technical practice, open-source collaboration, and campus exchange. Students interested in Web3, cybersecurity, open-source technology, and youth innovation are welcome to follow us.
home.orgPositionDesc: Organizing learning, sharing, collaboration, and open exchange as a campus tech community.
home.contentMethodDesc: The website serves as the unified showcase, with dynamic content synchronized to WeChat, X, and open-source platforms.

about.title: About
about.description: Learn about HNUDAO's positioning, vision, mission, organizational culture, and future direction.
about.introDesc: HNUDAO is the Blockchain Association at Henan Normal University, focusing on blockchain, Web3, cybersecurity, open-source technology, and student innovation. We aim to connect learning, research, sharing, and collaboration, helping more students enter real-world technical scenarios with lower barriers.
about.visionDesc: Build a campus blockchain community with technical depth, open atmosphere, and long-term collaboration capability.
about.missionDesc: Through public sharing, project practice, content accumulation, and peer collaboration, provide students with a platform for continuous growth.
about.cultureDesc: We aim to combine the open atmosphere of campus clubs with the collaborative approach of tech communities.
about.openCollabDesc: Encouraging cross-grade, cross-discipline cooperation. Students from all backgrounds are welcome to learn and build together.
about.techPracticeDesc: Emphasizing the transition from knowledge to real practice, creating a closed loop of sharing, projects, and retrospectives.
about.longTermDesc: Continuously accumulating content, projects, and experience, so each generation of members can build on the foundation of their predecessors.
about.futureDesc: The association will continue to expand around technical learning, content dissemination, project incubation, and internal/external collaboration.
about.futureItem1: Continue organizing public sharing, reading exchanges, and foundational technical learning activities.
about.futureItem2: Gradually accumulate project practices, knowledge resources, and open-source outcomes suitable for campus scenarios.
about.futureItem3: Explore establishing long-term collaboration with more students, clubs, and external communities.

sponsor.title: Sponsor
sponsor.description: View HNUDAO's public on-chain sponsor addresses to support association activities, content building, and project practice.
sponsor.whyDesc: HNUDAO welcomes sponsorship from alumni, friends, community partners, and supporters. Your support goes toward public events, content publishing, infrastructure, and project practice.
sponsor.activitySupportDesc: For public sharing, workshops, community events, and related organizational costs.
sponsor.contentBuildDesc: For the website, resource organization, design materials, and public content publishing.
sponsor.projectPracticeDesc: For open-source projects, experimental tools, and long-term collaborative outcomes.
sponsor.infrastructureDesc: For domain names, hosting, development collaboration, and other essential services.
sponsor.noticeTitle: Please Confirm Chain & Address Before Transfer
sponsor.notice1: Each chain requires its corresponding network. Do not send cross-chain directly.
sponsor.notice2: Ethereum, Optimism, Base, BNB Chain, Polygon, and Arbitrum currently share the same EVM address, but you must confirm the correct network before transfer.
sponsor.notice3: For larger sponsorships, we recommend contacting the association via email first to confirm usage and receiving arrangements.
sponsor.walletsDesc: Click the copy button to quickly copy the corresponding network address. Please double-check the chain, currency, and address before initiating a transfer.
sponsor.ctaDesc: If you'd like to collaborate, understand sponsor usage, or confirm before transferring, please contact us via email first.
